purpose: All words of widths0..10 are erased and re-prepared by the finite controller, checking every represented cell, exit and absolute head. An additional test initializes the marker on a blank tape in two steps. Universal execution proofs cover arbitrary widths.
source:
import TransposeFollowup.NativeBuffer
open TransposeFollowup FixedTapeCompiler
open CopyMachine

def bits (m a : Nat) : List Bool := (List.range m).map a.testBit

def bufferChecks : Nat × Nat := Id.run do
  let mut count := 0
  let mut failed := 0
  for m in List.range 11 do
    for a in List.range (2^m) do
      let final := NativeZipper.run NativeBuffer.program (4*m+6)
        (NativeBuffer.cfg (.erase 2) (Counter.marked (bits m a)) (fun _ => -31))
      let expected : Tape Bool := ⟨[.start], List.replicate (m+1) .blank⟩
      count := count + 1
      if !(decide (final.core.pc = .done) && decide (final.core.tapes 0 = expected) &&
          decide (final.pos 0 = -31)) then failed := failed + 1
  let initial := NativeZipper.run NativeBuffer.program 2
    (NativeBuffer.cfg (.erase 0) ⟨[],[]⟩ (fun _ => 31))
  count := count + 1
  if !(decide (initial.core.pc = .done) &&
      decide (initial.core.tapes 0 = (⟨[.start],[]⟩ : Tape Bool)) &&
      decide (initial.pos 0 = 31)) then failed := failed + 1
  return (count, failed)
#eval bufferChecks
